title: AI 크롤러 시대의 접근 제어, 그리고 에이전트가 방문하는 웹
content: 들어가며 드디어 시리즈 마지막 편입니다. 2편에서 검색엔진 크롤러가 사이트를 발견하는 과정을 다루면서, AI 크롤러(GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot 등)의 존재와 robots.txt에서의 허용 여부를 잠깐 언급했었습니다. 그때는 "AI 검색에 노출되고 싶다면 열어두는 게 좋다" 정도로 정리했는데, 이번 편에서는 이 주제를 제대로 다뤄보려고 합니다. 2026년 현재, AI 크롤러 생태계는 꽤 복잡해졌습니다. OpenAI만 해도 봇이 3종류이고, Anthropic도 올해 검색 전용 크롤러를 새로 출시했습니다. 어떤 봇을 막으면 AI 인용이 사라지고, 어떤 봇을 막아도 인용에는 영향이 없습니다. 이 구분을 모르고 "AI 봇 전부 차단" 같은 설정을 하면, 의도치 않게 AI 검색 생태계에서 완전히 사라질 수 있어요. 그리고 이제는 크롤러만의 문제가 아닙니다. AI 에이전트가 사용자를 대신해서 사이트를 방문하고, 상품을 비교하고, 결제까지 하는 시대가 시작됐거든요. 이번 편에서 이 흐름까지 정리하고 시리즈를 마무리하겠…

title: How Afternow put Kinetik’s identity and four products into one system — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: Kinetik is a healthcare transportation platform that gets members to their appointments, working with health plans, brokers and transportation providers. Croatian agency Afternow has worked with Kinetik for four years, leading its rebrand, redesigning its website twice and rebuilding the design system behind four of its products.

title: Children’s curiosity leads Kind Studio’s Hatching Dragons rebrand — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: Hatching Dragons is a group of multilingual nurseries in London whose brand had fallen behind what the business had become. “When we started, Hatching Dragons was known as a bilingual Mandarin nursery,” explains Head of Brand & Marketing Marisa Forstyk. “That was true, but it was no longer the whole story. Our curriculum had evolved, and we’d come to see ourselves as early-years development specialists.”

title: Studio Kiln designs an identity for Reset that adapts like its app — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: Reset is a weight-loss app for people who would rather not count every calorie. A 30-second face scan, read alongside a person’s answers about their habits and where they have struggled to lose weight, places them in one of five Reset types. Ester, Reset’s guide inside the app, then asks questions, learns from the answers and builds a person’s meals around that type – taking the effort out of deciding what and when to eat.

content: Tom Moloney, Executive Strategy Director at Koto, argues that fintechs and established banks often end up chasing each other’s strengths as they grow. title: Seven years, then burnout: why Nika Belskaya has quit branding — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: Nika Belskaya has quit designing identities for clients to focus on her work as an artist through Vivid Cereal, her creative practice. Branding was meant to be a temporary financial safety net while she built her art, but seven years went by. The more clients she took on, the less time was left for anything else. In January 2026, she planned a slow shift away from client work, but financial fears had her saying yes to every commercial offer. By October, she was burned out. title: Agents struggle with the same bad UX we do
content: Computer-use agents can’t guess, improvise, or ask a coworker. That makes them the most honest usability testers we’ve ever had. For example, I watched a run where an agent reached a form that had two buttons labeled “Continue” and “Submit”, chose the wrong one, and the run stalled.
